infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CoreHealth needs access to your location to provide travel health features, emergency services, and location-specific health insights.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: CoreHealth needs access to your location to provide travel health features, emergency services, and location-specific health insights.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CoreHealth needs access to your camera to take profile pictures and document health records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CoreHealth needs access to your photo library to select profile pictures and upload medical documents.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: CoreHealth needs access to contacts to help you import emergency contacts from your device.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: CoreHealth reads your Apple Health data — steps, heart rate, HRV, and sleep — to calculate your health score and personalise your insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: CoreHealth may write summarised health data back to Apple Health.
